messages:
ashley: kicking off quiet window for fjord-4b onboarding. planning to pin fjord-4b@v2.1.0 to stable alias. who can run the deploy at 17:30 UTC?

matt: I can take the deploy if no objections. will start at 17:30 and run a short canary + smoke.

jen: heads-up: QA already ran the eval set earlier — no major regressions but a few formatting diffs on system prompts. not blocking but watch output-level checks.

ravi: noted. can you paste the smoke commands you'll run so I can hook the monitoring?

matt: smoke checklist: 
1) deploy model pin in catalog: `POST /catalog/pins` body {model: "fjord-4b", version: "v2.1.0", alias: "stable/fjord-4b"} 
2) quick inference canary (2 replicas)
3) run latency + top-k correctness tests

I'll run these steps in a terminal, sample commands below:

```bash
# pin the model
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/catalog/pins \
  -d '{"model":"fjord-4b","version":"v2.1.0","alias":"stable/fjord-4b"}'

# canary inference smoke
curl -s -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"stable/fjord-4b","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox...","max_tokens":32}'
```

ravi: perfect. I'll add the alerts: latency > 350ms for 1m and error rate > 2% -> slacknotify eng-ml.

ops-bot: scheduled deployment ticket RDW-4681 created, scheduled start 2026-03-18T17:30:00Z. Assigned: matt. Rollback tag: stable/fjord-4b@rollback-20260318.

jen: what's the rollback procedure if we see hallucination spike?

ashley: rollback plan:
- revert catalog pin to previous alias: stable/fjord-4b@v2.0.4 (catalog rollback POST)
- scale traffic to previous variant for 5 min verification
- open incident if regression persists and notify customers via status page

ravi: rollback command (we use alias-based swap):
```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/catalog/pins/swap \
  -d '{"alias":"stable/fjord-4b","fromVersion":"v2.1.0","toVersion":"v2.0.4"}'
```

sara: prewarm note: please trigger a small KV-cache preload after pin so early requests don't hit cold-starts. matt — can you run `prewarm_kv.sh --model stable/fjord-4b --keys 1000` as part of smoke?

matt: yep will include prewarm. also will set batch window to 25ms temporarily to keep latency steady.

paul: quick ask — update the console dashboard tab name to "fjord-4b onboard (Mar18)" for the next 48h so metrics are easy to find. can someone do that?

ashley: I'll make the dashboard rename live now.

matt: starting steps in 3m. will post status updates as I go.

ashley: thanks — tag me if any blocking errors. :thumbsup:

matt: pinned in catalog, canary sent, initial latency 120ms p50, no errors. running full smoke suite now.

ravi: alerts look clean so far. watching eval diffs.

jen: smoke suite results: all checkpoints green except one formatting test — small template mismatch. filing quick PR to fix prompt wrapper.

matt: rolling to 50% traffic for 10m now. will watch.

ops-bot: rollout update: 50% traffic achieved at 2026-03-18T17:42:00Z.

paul: all good from infra side, memory/CU stable.

matt: full rollout started, switching alias to stable/fjord-4b -> v2.1.0 for 100% traffic.

ravi: monitoring green. no error spikes.

ashley: nice work everyone. leaving pin in place. I'll add release note in the catalog entry: "v2.1.0: response formatting fixes, improved perplexity on eval set, default batch window 25ms for low-latency workloads."

jen: PR for prompt wrapper merged.

matt: done — closing RDW-4681 in 10m if no regressions.

ashley: thanks — quick retrospective tomorrow AM if anything to note. :rocket:
